seed: Pick several shapes that do not agree about a part and the switch has to say so rather than picking a side. This walk draws three boxes, switches the border off on one of them, picks all three, and reads the Border row: it says Mixed, and the line under it counts how many have one. One press makes all three agree, and ONE undo puts all three back the way they were. Then the same question is asked of Fill, so the answer is the row's rule and not one row's special case. (Shadow was the part this walk used until 2026-09-07, when a shadow became an effect you add rather than a part a shape has. The line round a shape followed it on 2026-09-08: it is a Border in the Effects list rather than an Outline row in Appearance, and the row answers the same way.)

steps.note: one box with no line round it, so the selection about to be made really does disagree
three picked, one bare: the Border row says Mixed beside a switch drawn one step quieter, and the line under it says 2 of the 3 have one
one press: all three have a line, the word is gone and the switch is at full strength
ONE undo puts all three back: the first box is bare again and the row says Mixed again
the same answer on another part: two of the three still have a fill, so the Fill row says Mixed too
